meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
All procedures outlined in Education Code 48900 et seq. shall be followed.
A teacher may suspend any pupil from the teacher's class, per Education Code 48910 and/or Board Policy 5119, for the day of the suspension and the day following.
The District and the Association shall apply for a waiver of the instructional minutes requirement of Education Code Section 46201 if it becomes necessary to declare more than two (2) modified days in any school year under the circumstances stated below:
All matters not specifically enumerated as within the scope of negotiations or the consulting rights of the Association in Government Code 3543.2 are reserved to the District.
For purposes of this Article, discipline shall not be defined to include termination, suspension pursuant to Education Code Sections 44939 and 44940, or non-re-election pursuant to California Education Code Section 44882, nor does this Article in any way limit the District's right to initiate such procedures.

meta_cites_federal_law_008.answer: On-site teachers shall not be given a traveling teacher assignment if a physician verifies in writing that a reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act is recommended or that the teacher's health would be detrimentally affected.
